labor_category: Update the inventory of all DHCF IT infrastructure in order to identify where all FTI, PHI, and ePHI reside.
Updated Risk Assessment of the potential risks and vulnerabilities of DHCF’s business operations, including a current assessment of the confidentiality, integrity and availability of ePHI.

Draft and update Risk Management Plan, which would include mitigation recommendations consistent with HIPAA, HITECH, and Omnibus Rule regulatory requirements, including NIST publication SP 800-53a (Rev 4 or 5); NIST publication SP 800-66a, and; NIST publication SP 800-30.
Conduct and update the Business Impact Analysis (BIA) for all agencies of the DHCF (bi-annually or as needed)
Develop Implementation Pathway for identified Priority Risk #1 (based upon assessment and findings in Current Option year)
Develop Implementation Pathway for identified Priority Risk #2 (based upon assessment and findings in Current Option year) including tabletop simulation exercise and after action report
Develop Implementation pathway for identified Priority Risk #3 (based upon assessment findings in Current Option Year)
